home.title: Ngiyakwamukela ku-{{app}}
home.tagline: Umphakathi owodwa wokubuyela ekhaya nokuhlala uphilile.

area.comingSoon: Kuyeza maduze. Le ndawo eyesikhashana manje.

wellbeing.roughHelp: You are not alone. The crisis button above is always here — call or text 988, or 911 in an emergency.
wellbeing.locksHelp: Ungakhiya isici isonto elilodwa, amasonto amabili, inyanga eyodwa noma unomphela. Inkinobho yenhlekelele, usizo lokubuya, othintana nabo abaphephile nokusula idatha akuhlali kukhiyiwe.

community.noPhone: Izinombolo zocingo aziboniswa neze emiyalezweni phakathi kwethu.

support.resourcesNote: Legal aid, treatment and transit. This directory does not cover food or housing.

safety.relapseDraft: Draft — for review. Calm first steps for the first 24 hours after a slip will appear here once reviewed. You are not alone.
safety.safeContactsHelp: Gcina umxhasi wakho noma umngane wakho ophephile eduze.
safety.vaultHelp: Your documents are encrypted. Paid plan feature; no price has been set yet.
safety.wipeHelp: Lokhu kuyisula ngempela idatha yakho, akukho kubuya.
safety.wipeConfirm: Ngiyaqonda ukuthi lokhu kuyisula ngempela idatha yami.

reentry.tipsAnonymous: Amathiphu awanamagama. Izinombolo zocingo aziboniswa neze.
reentry.celebrationAll: Izinyathelo ezingu-33 ziqediwe. Gubha inqubekelaphambili yakho.
reentry.crisisStep: Londoloza lezi zinombolo manje. Ungacindezela futhi "Need help now" phezulu kwesikrini ngasinye.
reentry.resourceOnly: Isiqondiso sezinsiza kuphela — I-Groundwork ayikunikezi lokhu futhi ayisebenzi nanoma ubani.

steps.step7: Find a safe place to stay (call 211 or local housing resources)
steps.step8: Find food for this week (call 211 or a local food pantry)
steps.step14: Put every court date and check-in on a calendar
steps.step17: Check your fines, fees and restitution
steps.step19: Enroll in Medicaid, and SNAP if you need it
steps.step31: Xhumana nomndeni, lungisa ukusekelwa kwengane uma kudingeka
steps.step33: Beka umgomo wesikhathi eside ugubhe imihla yakho engama-90

work.paroleNote: Check your parole or probation conditions with your officer before applying.

journey.portfolioPrivate: Kuyimfihlo ngokuzenzakalela. Yabelana kuphela uma ukhetha.

venue.placeholder: Indawo yesikhashana — ikamelo lebhokisi elimpunga. Azikho izithombe zangempela zendawo; lena akuyona indawo yangempela.

family.help: Umndeni ubona kuphela lokho okhetha ukwabelana ngakho.

readAloud.title: Ukufunda okuzwakalayo
readAloud.help: Ukufunda okuzwakalayo kusebenzisa izwi ledivayisi yakho ukufunda umbiko.

phase3.resumeHelp: Yenza i-resume yombiko elula kusuka kokuhlangenwe nakho kwakho.
phase3.headline: Isihloko
phase3.interviewHelp: Zilolonge izimpendulo. Umqeqeshi wakho ukunika amamaki nethiphu elilodwa.
phase3.gigsHelp: Short local jobs. Check parole conditions with your officer. Phone numbers are never shown.
phase3.paidNote: Paid plan. No price has been set yet.
phase3.geoHelp: Abanye babona idolobha lakho kuphela. Indawo enembayo ayikaze yabelwane.
phase3.rideHelp: Cela ukugibela. Izinombolo zocingo aziboniswa neze. Hlanganani endaweni yomphakathi.
phase3.caption: Isihlokwana
phase3.merchHelp: Izimpawu zekhodi kuphela. Akukho okungaphandle okuchaza incazelo yazo, awekho amadethi aphrintiwe.
phase3.archiveHelp: Vala umlayezo wakho. Ivulwa ngosuku olubalulekile.
phase3.matchHelp: I-ejenti yakho ikhuluma nabanye aba-ejenti kuqala. Ukuphola kuvaliwe manje. Ungabona ukuthi kungani, ucele isingeniso uzame futhi.
phase3.datingOff: Ukuphola kuvaliwe kuze kubekwe umthetho wezinsuku ezincane.
phase3.carpoolHelp: Bheka lapha kuqala. Ongakukhetha, izinga ledolobha kuphela: bona ukuthi ubani oya emhlanganweni wakho uxhumane ngemiyalezo ye-app. Ayikho ifoni, ayikho indawo enembayo.
phase3.groupsHelp: Amaqembu okululama, ukwesekwa kokubuya, ukholo nomphakathi ngedolobha nesikhathi somhlangano. Idatha yesampula kuphela — alulona uhlu lwangempela.
phase3.rideFallbackHelp: Kuboniswa kuphela uma kungekho muntu ebhodini oya emhlanganweni wakho. Kuthumela isicelo esilawulwayo ku-app — izinga ledolobha kuphela, ayikho ifoni.
phase3.noCarpoolMatch: Ayikho imoto ehlangene yalo mhlangano, ngakho-ke Ngidinga ukugibela kuboniswa njengesipesheli.
phase3.familyRideHelp: Abashayeli abagunyaziwe kuphela. Izaziso zihamba ngayinye-ngayinye ngokulinda kwamaminithi ama-2; uyaqinisekisa ngaphambi kokulandelayo.
phase3.housingHelp: Savings goals plus a housing-readiness plan. Groundwork does not provide housing and does not partner with providers. For local help, call 211.
phase3.musicHelp: Izingoma zesampula kuphela. Ayikho i-akhawunti yokusakaza. Isidlali siyacima kumamojula e-akademi nasezifundweni.
phase3.shareWho: Manje: wena kuphela. Ukwenza isixhumanisi kuvumela noma ubani onesixhumanisi ukuthi afunde.
phase3.suggestHelp: Iziphakamiso kuphela — akukho okushicilelwayo uze ukungeze.

crisisReply.openCrisis: Vula inkinobho yenhlekelele nothintana nabo abaphephile
